## Change

Describe the reader-facing or repository outcome.

## Editorial contract

- [ ] Module, target page, and duplicate coverage were checked in `content/plan.json`.
- [ ] Language, terminology, notation, learning objectives, and handoff are coherent.
- [ ] Authorship or reuse rights were confirmed for incoming text and media.
- [ ] Claims, datasets, and visuals have traceable citations or provenance.
- [ ] New executable content uses the canonical `.py:percent` source and regenerated `.ipynb`.
- [ ] `_toc.yml`, `myst.yml`, and `notebooks/manifest.json` changed only when their boundary changed.
- [ ] Module readiness and gaps were updated when the change materially affects them.

## Validation

- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] `make check-book-content`
- [ ] `make check-notebook-sources`
- [ ] `make lint`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make publish-check`

List any intentionally skipped check and the exact reason.
